title: guardrail.check node config (N-4, safety class: mandatory, non-removable)
description: Fail-CLOSED safety check on the generated text. Calls POST /guardrail/analyze. `failOn` is restricted to `unsafe_or_unknown` in v1 — a `GuardrailResponse` carrying a non-null `error`, a transport failure, or a timeout is treated as NO VERDICT (never as `safe=true`), so the node's own gate must not tolerate 'unsafe' alone (which would silently treat an error/unknown outcome as a pass). This node's presence and the graph's inability to route around it are enforced structurally by the validator (WF-SUMM-* rules), not by the Studio canvas.
